$comment: Movie Mafia subjects. The imposter's clue must be true enough to survive a round of conversation and wrong enough to trip them up under questioning — vague where the real clue is specific. If the imposter clue is simply a different film, the bluff is impossible; if it is identical, the game has no imposter.
